system_description.narrative_title: Global shift to higher rates and bond-market stress
system_description.narrative_summary: A coordinated move toward monetary tightening — led by a hawkish Federal Reserve under Kevin Warsh and echoed by other central banks (BOJ, BoE, RBA) — is driving a sharp repricing of sovereign yields and a global bond-market sell-off. Rising inflation and an oil price rebound are amplifying yield moves, creating market volatility, cross-border capital flows and political friction as borrowing costs rise for governments, corporations and households. The interaction between central-bank decisions, real yields and investor behavior is opening a new regime of higher rates with systemic spillovers.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary: central-bank policy decisions (Fed, BOJ, BoE, RBA), short- and long-term interest rates and yield curves (US Treasuries and global sovereigns), inflation metrics, commodity price shocks (notably oil), bond market liquidity and investor flows (hedge funds, foreign investors, pension funds), FX reactions (yen, dollar), and market-implied expectations for future policy. Also included are real-economy transmission channels (mortgages, corporate borrowing, government debt servicing) and political responses (administration pressure on central banks).
system_description.super_system: Global macroeconomic and financial system (international capital markets, trade, and the real economy)
adjacent_subsystems: Energy markets (oil price shocks and supply/demand dynamics)
Sovereign fiscal policy and public debt management
Real economy: households, corporate credit markets, and housing/consumer finance

variables.name: Short-term policy interest rate
variables.description: The nominal interest rate at the short end of the yield curve set by monetary authorities (overnight / policy benchmark rate).

variables.name: Long-term sovereign yield
variables.description: The benchmark nominal yield on long-dated sovereign debt that reflects term premia and long-run rate expectations.

variables.name: Yield curve slope
variables.description: The difference between long-term and short-term yields indicating term structure steepness and expectations about future rates.

variables.name: Inflation rate
variables.description: The observed pace of change in a broad consumer price index over a recent 12-month period.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: The market and household consensus forecast of future inflation over the medium term.

variables.name: Real yield level
variables.description: The inflation-adjusted return on long-term sovereign debt (nominal yield minus expected inflation).

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: The prevailing global benchmark price of crude oil per barrel, reflecting energy cost shocks.

variables.name: Bond market liquidity
variables.description: The depth and ease with which sovereign and corporate bonds can be bought or sold without large price impact.

variables.name: Bond market volatility
variables.description: The realized or implied short- to medium-term variability of bond prices and yields.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Net financial flows moving across national borders into or out of debt and equity assets per unit time.

variables.name: Exchange rate index
variables.description: A trade-weighted measure of the currency complex that captures aggregate foreign exchange strength or weakness.

variables.name: Market-implied policy expectations
variables.description: The probability-weighted market view of future central-bank policy rate paths as implied by asset prices.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: The aggregate tolerance for risk among investors, reflected in allocations between risky and safe assets.

variables.name: Government debt servicing cost
variables.description: The interest payments on public debt paid over a given period, measured relative to GDP or as an absolute flow.

variables.name: Corporate borrowing spread
variables.description: The premium that corporate borrowers pay over risk-free benchmarks for issuing debt.

variables.name: Household debt service
variables.description: The aggregate interest and principal payments by households on outstanding debt relative to income per period.

catalysts.title: Further Fed hikes this year
catalysts.description: Market and Fed commentary point to at least one or more additional Fed policy rate increases before year-end, lifting policy rates and yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Fed policymakers forecast one more rate hike', 'Fed delivers first hike... sees more tightening ahead', 'How high will rates need to go?'

catalysts.title: Fed communication-driven market moves
catalysts.description: Kevin Warsh's speeches and Fed guidance are likely to drive near-term shifts in policy expectations and bond volatility as markets parse intent.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Warsh's words may matter', 'Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering', 'Warsh lays out forces driving up bond yields'.

catalysts.title: BOJ continued tightening
catalysts.description: Following a 31-year high hike, the BOJ looks likely to continue tightening or accelerate normalization, altering yield spreads and FX flows from Japan.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'BOJ raises rates to highest since 1995', 'BOJ picks up pace of tightening', 'Bank of Japan lifts rates as global tightening cycle takes shape'.

catalysts.title: Sustained elevated oil prices
catalysts.description: Recent jump to around $109 could persist or re-spike, adding upward pressure to inflation and long-end yields while increasing market stress.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Global bond sell-off reignites as oil jumps to $109', 'Oil price surge revives prospect of BoE rate rise'.

catalysts.title: Heavy US Treasury issuance / auctions
catalysts.description: Ongoing large Treasury supply and auction dynamics (buybacks, auction demand) will affect long-term yields, liquidity and cross-border demand in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Weak Buyback and Strong Auctions', 'Treasury yields hitting 5%... the clock is ticking', 'China’s US Treasury holdings fall'.

catalysts.title: Foreign shift away from Treasuries
catalysts.description: Evidence of declining foreign holdings and preference for equities suggests continued reallocations away from Treasuries, tightening term premia and FX effects.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'China’s US Treasury holdings fall to lowest level since 2008', 'Foreign investors prefer US stocks to Treasuries as debt worries grow'.

catalysts.title: Deterioration in mortgage and structured bonds
catalysts.description: Analysts warn mortgage bond deterioration that could spread stress across fixed-income markets, reducing liquidity and widening spreads.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Why mortgage bonds are set to deteriorate, and possibly hit the whole market'.

catalysts.title: BOE gilt-sales overhaul and possible hikes
catalysts.description: BoE signals to overhaul gilt sales and has shifted tone toward rate hikes, potentially altering gilt liquidity and UK/global yield dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bank of England shifts tone toward rate hikes', 'BoE overhauls gilt sales', 'Oil surge revives prospect of BoE rate rise'.
